main_candidate_pool.review_selection: One first archive example per normalized subject, SHA256(seed:raw_sha256) order, first16;12 substantive technical questions/replies retained after reading full normalized subject/body. Other4 not assigned a label.

procedure.archive_parser: Python mailbox.mbox.iterkeys/get_bytes (avoids non-ASCII Mailman envelope from-line decoding); v77_mail.parse_eml for MIME/legacy charset handling
procedure.language_filter: Pinned fastText lid.176.ftz top1 __label__ru with probability>=0.8 on whitespace-flattened first10000 normalized subject/body chars; no email spam classifier used
procedure.identity_and_prefix_family: v78_data.identifiers on complete v77_mail.parse_eml output; counts do not certify absence of thread/quoted-text leakage
